plastmak-211.summary: An end milling machine shapes the end of a mullion (transom) to the contour of the frame profile it butts against, so the joint closes tight. The heavier SÇ 211S mills aluminum to high quality from −45° to +45° on mechanical stops, with cutters up to Ø6-5/16″ (160 mm) and a second 7-7/8″ (200 mm) stack; a whole cutter group changes with one button and three more wait on the rack, the support adjusts to four profiles, the feed is hydro-pneumatic and a boron-oil spray cools the cut.

plastmak-902.name: SÇ 902 hydraulic corner crimping machine for aluminum, profiles to 5-1/8″ high
plastmak-902.summary: Aluminum window and door frames are joined at the corner with a cleat inside the profile; the corner crimper presses knives into the profile walls over the cleat and locks the 90° joint. plastmak-screw.name: Screwing machines and sash assembly machine, screws to 4.2 × 38 mm
plastmak-screw.models_label: Single screwing · double-head screwing · sash assembly · 3 machines
plastmak-screw.summary: Assembly stations for the steps after the frame is welded or crimped. The single screwing machine drives screws from 3.9 × 16 mm to 4.2 × 38 mm with a pneumatic motor and stable torque control, its working range set between 1.6″ and 4.7″ and its cycle started by a foot pedal — compact enough to slot into a line, fed by an automatic screw feeder. The double-head screwing machine drives two screws at once into PVC and aluminum profiles. The sash assembly machine fits single and double opening hardware in series without moulds or templates: laser alignment, automatic measuring and screwing, a three-arm drilling unit, a hinge template and an espagnolette groove cutter — 3.5 minutes on average for a double opening window.

plastmak-conveyor.name: SÇ 1000 digital measuring conveyor, 9′ 10″, ±.020″, and SÇ 1001 – 1003 roller conveyors
plastmak-conveyor.summary: Conveyors carry long profiles to and from the saws and machines at table height. The SÇ 1000 is a digital measuring conveyor: 9′ 10″ (3 m) long, it sets its stop to the length entered on the touch screen to ±.020″ (±0.5 mm), retracts the stop at one push so the cut piece comes out freely, calibrates easily and fits any of the saws, on a 220 V single-phase supply.
